target.title: fix(codex): unblock plugin checks after 0.144.2 [AI]
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where Codex plugin changes on `main` fail the Plugin NPM Release preflight after a newer required Codex runtime patch is published. The guard rejected `@openai/codex` 0.144.1 because npm latest is 0.144.2.

## Why This Change Was Made

Updates the managed runtime pin to 0.144.2 and keeps the pnpm lockfile, plugin shrinkwrap, manifest assertion, and harness documentation synchronized. Direct comparison of upstream Codex `rust-v0.144.1..rust-v0.144.2` confirmed identical `codex-rs/app-server`, `codex-rs/app-server-protocol`, and `codex-rs/exec` trees; this patch does not require an OpenClaw protocol adaptation.

## User Impact

Codex plugin release checks no longer fail on the stale runtime requirement, and managed installations receive the current Codex patch release.

## Evidence

- Before: [main Plugin NPM Release run 29226190969](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29226190969) failed with `@openai/codex must match npm latest; found 0.144.1, latest is 0.144.2`.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxd03desfc57wpq2ytxh1kmq`: full Codex plugin suite passed, 106 files / 2,490 tests.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxd175jpjxfa2ycrx9gj4jnw`: frozen install, generated shrinkwrap check, selected plugin release preflight, manifest test, `codex-cli 0.144.2` smoke, and full `pnpm check:changed` all passed after rebasing onto `a5883c33d11`.
- Fresh structured autoreview: no accepted or actionable findings.
